subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should `agents_list` expose operator-authored per-agent descriptions to authorized orchestrators as the supported dynamic-discovery contract?
rationale: Source and runtime proof establish a narrow implementation, but only maintainers can approve the permanent trust, visibility, and size contract for model-visible free-text metadata.

options.title: Expose bounded descriptions
options.body: Refresh and land the linked implementation with existing allowlist filtering, blank omission, explicit bounds, documentation, and focused tests.

options.title: Keep discovery structural
options.body: Reject free-text descriptions and retain only IDs, names, runtime metadata, and explicit routing configuration.

recommendation.title: Expose bounded descriptions
recommendation.body: Refresh and land the linked implementation with existing allowlist filtering, blank omission, explicit bounds, documentation, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced both `agents_list` and the central multi-agent config/routing behavior, making him the strongest history-backed decision owner.
